meta.name: paid-advertising
meta.description: Plans, runs, and optimizes paid acquisition across search, social, and display — account structure, targeting, creative, bidding, budget, and the analysis that says whether to scale or stop. Use this to set up or restructure campaigns, write and iterate ad creative, diagnose rising costs or falling performance, decide budget allocation, or judge whether a channel is working.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划投放搜索、社交、展示广告,诊断成本上涨并优化预算分配。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营广告账户,想知道哪些钱该加、哪些该停。
copy.tagline_en: Launch and refine paid ad campaigns across channels, and know when to scale or stop.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid acquisition and need to scale winners and cut losers.

howto.what: Claude 会规划、投放并优化付费广告:搭建或重构广告系列与账户结构,撰写和迭代广告文案,诊断成本上涨或效果下滑,决定预算分配,并判断渠道该加量还是停止。
howto.when: 当请求涉及搭建或重构广告系列、撰写或迭代广告文案、诊断成本上涨或效果下滑等付费投放事项时,该技能会启用。

say.text: 帮我按搜索意图分层搭建广告系列,并先定好命名的统一规则。
say.note: 会先从最高可接受获客成本与转化追踪检查开始。

say.text: 搜索广告成本涨了、转化没变,帮我看看是不是素材疲劳。
say.note: 会按展示、点击、转化等顺序诊断。

say.text: 帮我判断这个渠道该不该加预算,给个复查日期和停投线。
say.note: 不满足显著性前不会建议扩量。

howto.what_en: Claude will plan, run, and optimize paid advertising: set up or restructure campaigns and account structure, write and iterate ad creative, diagnose rising costs or falling performance, decide budget allocation, and judge whether to scale or stop a channel.
howto.when_en: Use this when the request involves setting up or restructuring campaigns, writing or iterating ad creative, diagnosing rising costs or falling performance, deciding budget allocation, or judging whether a channel is working.

say_en.text: Set up search campaigns by intent tier, with a consistent naming convention.
say_en.note: It starts with max acceptable cost and verified tracking.

say_en.text: Search ad costs are rising but conversions are flat — is this creative fatigue?
say_en.note: It diagnoses in order: impressions, CTR, conversion, CPA.

say_en.text: Should I increase this channel’s budget? Set a review date and a kill threshold.
say_en.note: It won’t recommend scaling before results are significant.
